critique: The render retains the warm gold glow, black field, dense luminous center, and active particle variation appropriate to a magical effect. It is more evenly distributed by t4, but it still reads as a compact spark burst rather than the broad, coherent elliptical magic-disc silhouette of the preset thumbnail. The effect occupies only a small central portion of the frame and has no clearly legible disc plane; its outer particles disperse irregularly from a bright blob.

suggestions.why: Give the grid emitter substantial horizontal extent so the particle mass establishes a wide disc silhouette instead of originating as a compact point blob.
Add a smaller perpendicular emitter extent to produce a readable flattened ellipse while keeping the disc wider than it is tall.
Reduce outward velocity so particles remain concentrated over the enlarged emitter plane rather than breaking into an irregular burst.
